title: Tell HN: Thank you for not redesigning Hacker News
guide_zh: 身处慢速网络地区的用户感谢 HN 保留简洁设计，让页面仍能迅速加载。
author: ramphastidae
excerpt: I’m currently in a country with low speed internet and the entire ‘modern’ web is basically unusable except HN, which still loads instantly. Reddit, Twitter, news and banking sites are all painfully slow or simply time out altogether. To PG, the mods and whoever else is responsible: thank you for not trying to ‘fix’ what isn’t broken.
